findings.title: Stale 'Caisse FoodKing' eyebrow label persists in POS V5 components after Wave Y rebrand
findings.description: POS Orders Tracker page header shows 'CAISSE FOODKING' (eyebrow text style). Grep across resources/js identifies 3 hardcoded occurrences: FloorplanComponent.vue:6 'Caisse FoodKing · Plan de salle', PosComponent.vue:80 'Caisse FoodKing', PosOrdersTrackerComponent.vue:14 'Caisse FoodKing'. CSS comment also references the brand in pos-v5-tokens.css:93. These are static strings, NOT $t() keys, so the Wave Y FoodKing → Le Cayenne rebrand missed them.
findings.remediation: Replace 3 hardcoded 'Caisse FoodKing' string literals with $t('pos.brand_eyebrow') or 'Caisse Le Cayenne' static text (per Wave Y rebrand pattern). Rebuild Mix bundle (pos-shell.js currently has the stale string baked in).

findings.title: Round-2 spec stock-rupture default capture rendered blank on first shot (timing race)
findings.description: C-06 main spec uses 5500ms wait after domcontentloaded for /admin/stock/rupture. On this run the page hadn't completed Vue mount + categories fetch when screenshot fired (sidebar visible, main content empty). Re-shot via follow-up spec C-06-fix with 8000ms wait + selector poll — page rendered correctly. Product is NOT defective; this is a flaky capture timing only.
findings.remediation: Increase wait to 8000ms in main spec OR add explicit waitForSelector('text=/EN STOCK|RUPTURE/i') gate. Follow-up captures C-06-fix-* prove the page works.

findings.title: Several admin secondary routes still 404 on direct nav: /admin/branches /admin/stock-rupture-dashboard /order-status-screen (anon)
findings.description: Same as round-1 — these routes are SPA 404s (server returns 200 HTML; Vue router rejects). /admin/branches real route is nested at /admin/settings/filiales; /admin/stock-rupture-dashboard canonical is /admin/stock/rupture; /order-status-screen requires /admin/ prefix. Not a regression, just stale URL aliases never wired up.
findings.remediation: Either add Vue router redirects (e.g. '/admin/branches' → '/admin/settings/filiales') OR leave as-is (admin sidebar navigates via correct internal links). Deferred V1.0.2 alias-redirects backlog.
